name: Citaglobal Berhad
overview: 2026年，Citaglobal 完成收购 Zeqna Corporation 与 Koridor Mentari 各70%股权，并通过子公司 CGEM 增持 LAWI Engineering GmbH 至全资；能源板块与 TNB Power Generation、TIZA AI 签署谅解备忘录，拟在 Gebeng 工业区为 AI 数据中心园区开发离网供电方案；并终止与吉尔吉斯共和国能源部的谅解备忘录合作。物业板块就 Jalan Tun Razak 约1.58英亩土地与 Varia Crest 推进 Citaglobal Tower 联合开发。
overview_en: In 2026, Citaglobal completed the acquisitions of 70% equity interests in Zeqna Corporation and Koridor Mentari, and through subsidiary CGEM increased its stake in LAWI Engineering GmbH to full ownership; the energy segment signed an MOU with TNB Power Generation and TIZA AI for an off-grid power supply solution for a proposed AI data centre park at Gebeng Industrial Area;

segments.name: 能源
segments.note: 今年与 TNB Power Generation 及 TIZA AI 签署谅解备忘录，拟为 Gebeng 工业区 AI 数据中心园区开发离网供电方案；与吉尔吉斯共和国能源部的合作备忘录到期后不再推进。
segments.note_en: This year it signed an MOU with TNB Power Generation and TIZA AI for an off-grid power supply solution for a proposed AI data centre park at Gebeng Industrial Area, and did not proceed further with th…

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 全资子公司 Citaglobal New Energy 与 TNB Power Generation、TIZA AI 签署谅解备忘录，拟联合开发向 Gebeng 工业区 AI 数据中心园区供电的离网电力供应方案。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Citaglobal New Energy signed an MOU with TNB Power Generation and TIZA AI to jointly develop an off-grid power supply solution for a proposed AI data centre park at Gebeng Industrial Area.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 与吉尔吉斯共和国能源部（MEKR）的谅解备忘录已到期，公司经可行性研究后决定现阶段不再推进该合作。
actions.text_en: The MOU with the Ministry of Energy of the Kyrgyz Republic (MEKR) expired and, following feasibility studies, the company will not proceed further with the proposed collaboration at this juncture.

segments.name: 土木工程与建筑
segments.note: 今年完成收购 Zeqna Corporation 与 Koridor Mentari 各70%股权。
segments.note_en: This year it completed the acquisitions of 70% equity interests in Zeqna Corporation and Koridor Mentari.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 收购 Zeqna Corporation Sdn Bhd 及 Koridor Mentari Sdn Bhd 各70%股权，已于2026年11月17日完成。
actions.text_en: Acquired 70% equity interest each in Zeqna Corporation Sdn Bhd and Koridor Mentari Sdn Bhd, completed on 17 November 2026.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 就 Zeqna 收购事项与卖方签订补充协议，将剩余 Zeqna 收购代价修订为 RM10,500,000。
actions.text_en: Entered into a supplemental agreement with the Zeqna vendor revising the remaining Zeqna consideration to RM10,500,000.

segments.name: 物业发展
segments.note: 今年推进与 Varia Crest 的联营开发。
segments.note_en: This year it progressed the proposed JV with Varia Crest and proposed to divest its 20% stake in Manjaran.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 000,000 出售 Manjaran Sdn Bhd 全部20%股权予 Berjaya Property Berhad，代价以发行 BProperty 新股支付。
actions.text_en: Proposed to divest its entire 20% equity interest in Manjaran Sdn Bhd to Berjaya Property Berhad for RM50,000,000, satisfied via issuance of new BProperty shares.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 间接全资子公司 Citaglobal Property Development 与 Varia Crest 就 Jalan Tun Razak 约1.58英亩土地开发 Citaglobal Tower 的联营计划继续推进。
actions.text_en: Indirect wholly-owned subsidiary Citaglobal Property Development continued progressing the proposed JV with Varia Crest for the Citaglobal Tower development on approximately 1.58 acres at Jalan Tun Razak.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年完成 CGEM 引入 TIZA Global 为股东，并增持 LAWI Engineering GmbH 至全资。
segments.note_en: This year CGEM brought in TIZA Global as a shareholder and increased its stake in LAWI Engineering GmbH to full ownership.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 子公司 CGEM 以 EUR150,000 认购 LAWI Engineering GmbH 150,000 股新股，000股 LAWI 股份。
actions.text_en: Subsidiary CGEM subscribed 150,000 new shares in LAWI Engineering GmbH for EUR150,000 and acquired all 26,000 LAWI shares held by Dieter Langer.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 上述 CGEM 股份认购已于2026年6月30日完成。
actions.text_en: The CGEM share subscription was completed on 30 June 2026.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司 CGEM 与 TIZA Global 签订认购协议，后者以 RM4,000,000 认购 CGEM 1,562,500 股新股，占扩大后股本约43.86%。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary CGEM entered into a subscription agreement with TIZA Global, which subscribed 1,562,500 new CGEM shares for RM4,000,000, representing approximately 43.86% of the enlarged issued shares.

model_changes.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
model_changes.text: 通过谅解备忘录拟联合开发面向 AI 数据中心园区的离网发电及供电设施，涉及发电业务。
model_changes.text_en: Through an MOU, it proposes to jointly develop off-grid power generation and supply facilities for an AI data centre park, involving power generation.

model_changes.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
model_changes.text: 终止与吉尔吉斯共和国能源部的合作备忘录，不再推进该海外能源合作。
model_changes.text_en: Discontinued the MOU with the Ministry of Energy of the Kyrgyz Republic and will not proceed further with the overseas energy collaboration.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 出售 Manjaran 20%股权，完成后 Manjaran 不再为联营公司。
model_changes.text_en: Divesting the 20% stake in Manjaran; upon completion Manjaran will cease to be an associate company.
